decisionPolicy.rule: Unimplemented is not DROP or DEFER without explicit product approval.

requirements.requirement: Feature-rich multi-group Ribbon with File, History, Clipboard, Edit, Selection, Visibility, Arrange, Timeline, Annotation, View, Review and AI surfaces.

requirements.requirement: Left Signal/Group tree with arbitrary groups, role badges, independent columns, reorder and search/filter.

requirements.requirement: 20 Golden Samples and feature-coverage acceptance harness across GUI, waveform, persistence and export.

coveragePolicy: Every discovered pre-V2 issue is retained in the source universe; requirements may group issues by one canonical/product contract, but each issue must remain traceable to a row or explicit review note.
